rules.accepted_credit_types: Traditional pathway: courses offered by a PTBC-recognized continuing competency approval agency or by a provider approved by one of them (the Board does not approve courses or providers); college coursework at an accredited institution. Alternate pathway activities per 16 CCR §1399.94(b).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal (first 13-24 months of licensure): 15 hours (4 BLS + 2 ethics/laws/regulations + 9 other) if the renewal payment is submitted on or before the expiration date; 30 hours if submitted after it.
rules.audit_note: Do not submit proof with the renewal; keep documentation 5 years after the activity and submit it if audited by the Board.

topics.who: Basic life support course comparable to or more advanced than AHA BLS for Healthcare Providers, hands-on required; credited at 4 hours regardless of length

rules.notes: PTs and PTAs have the same requirement: 30 hours = 4 BLS + 2 ethics/laws/regulations + 24 other. Biennial renewal; license expires the last day of the birth month; hours must be earned in the two years before expiration. Exemptions (abroad, military, health, other good cause) by application before renewal, not for two consecutive periods.
